name: "Freezer Friendly" Spicy Chipotle Smoked Sausage Stew with Beans, Sweet Potato & Bell Pepper (Batch-Cooking)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe makes about 16 cups of stew or 8 (2-cup) servings.
Slice sausage crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove sausage to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp cumin, ground
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, mince 2 chipotle peppers. Place in a small bowl, along with 2 tbsp adobo sauce, and set aside. (Reserve remaining chipotles and sauce for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (198 g) can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce

2 (258 g) can pinto beans
1 (258 g) can black beans

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are softened, add cooked sausage, minced chipotles, adobo sauce, beans, broth, tomatoes, and corn to the pot. Stir to combine the stew and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and stew is thickened, about 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth
2 (411 g) can fire-roasted diced tomatoes
2 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: While the stew is cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the stew is done, juice lime into the pot, add cilantro, then stir to combine. Set aside to cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes.
Once the stew has cooled to room temperature, divide between containers.

STORING: Cover each container with an air-tight lid (or wrap tightly with plastic wrap). Place in the freezer for up to 3 months. HEATING: For best results, thaw stew in the fridge overnight. Warm in a saucepan set over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 6-8 minutes.
